items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh. Vijay Iyer. He’s a piano player. And then Rudresh Mahanthappa. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. And oh. The tenor playing with him, I like. Rudish…

ctx.x: I listen to them, and there’s a few trumpet players. [Patch?] something. And a guitar player. I have him there. [inaudible] And this Indian fellow… Eli [Jai?]…
Oh. Vijay Iyer. He’s a piano player. And then Rudresh Mahanthappa.
